diagnostics.message: Best-practice lint: steps fastqc, seqtk_trim, cowpy, multiqc have no annotation (gxwf lint).

residual_runtime_risks.risk: Embedded GalaxyUserTool (cowpy) requires enable_beta_tool_formats and the Custom Tool Execution role on the test Galaxy.
residual_runtime_risks.proven_by: planemo test invocation importing the workflow

residual_runtime_risks.risk: Map-over of single-dataset FastQC/seqtk inputs across list:paired_or_unpaired and MultiQC reduction of the nested collection are not exercised in IWC.
residual_runtime_risks.proven_by: invocation step states and output collection structure

residual_runtime_risks.risk: seqtk_trimfq when: $(!inputs.when) with optional boolean skip_trim defaulting false.
residual_runtime_risks.proven_by: seqtk_trim job runs (not skipped) in the test invocation

residual_runtime_risks.risk: Connecting workflow text input multiqc_title to MultiQC title when left unset.
residual_runtime_risks.proven_by: multiqc job completes with null title

residual_runtime_risks.risk: checksum with decompress: true on fastqsanger.gz elements may hash compressed bytes.
